title: Email newsletter
one_liner: Build an email list you own, then earn from sponsors, recommendations and your own products.
pay: Free to start: Kit free up to 10,000 subscribers. beehiiv Boosts pay per subscriber you send to other newsletters (one case study: $25,000 from Boosts with about 31,000 subscribers).
steps: Pick a free tool (Kit or beehiiv).
Make one freebie and a welcome email.
Say a comment keyword in every video.
Send one useful email a week.
catch: Small lists earn small amounts; it takes months of weekly emails to grow.

match.first_step: Make one checklist freebie and a 4-line welcome email.
